purpose: Check before SMP outcome opening that the frozen dual-gate hysteresis implementation rejects generic temporal drift and can recover a deliberately event-aligned threshold signal at the minimum replication scale.

reversible_stationary.description: Stationary log-scale parent trajectory with independent low-amplitude noise and no event-aligned pulse.

monotonic_drift.description: Smoothly increasing log-scale parent trajectory with no event-aligned pulse.
monotonic_drift.expected: H may be positive and sign-flip may pass, but structured phase null should prevent frequent confirmatory support.

aligned_signal_moderate.description: Stationary/noisy parent trajectory plus +0.5 log1p pulse on the recolonization-side transition census.

aligned_signal_strong.description: Stationary/noisy parent trajectory plus +1.0 log1p pulse on the recolonization-side transition census.

boundary: This is a code/design recovery audit, not a formal power calculation for unknown SMP effect sizes.
The pulse magnitudes are synthetic calibration values and must not be interpreted as biological priors.
Failure triggers code/design review before SMP magnitude opening; it does not authorize tuning on real SMP outcomes.
